expectedOutcome: A rename from main to trunk resolves trunk from the live HEAD symref without a code or policy change.
injectedEvent: Remote HEAD changes to refs/heads/trunk while local origin/HEAD still points to main.
invariants: Live remote metadata outranks the stale local fallback.
The resolver never substitutes a literal main value.
The resolved ref and SHA must be repinned before integration.
reviewPass: Reject stale local main and resolve refs/heads/trunk from live metadata.
reconciledResult: trunk is selected; integration still requires a newly pinned approval packet.
assumptions: The remote exposes a valid HEAD symref.
uncertainty: A provider that omits HEAD symref requires a stale-marked local fallback or a blocked result.
repairRoute: Block and request refreshed metadata; never guess the branch name.
